g.text: DATAVAULT EMBEDDED SYSTEM · HARDWARE PINOUT & CIRCUIT DIAGRAM
STM32F411CEU6 BlackPill | MicroSD SPI1 | SSD1306 I2C1 OLED | NodeMCU ESP8266 (ESP-12E) Wi-Fi
• NodeMCU has onboard 3.3V LDO and EN pull-up.
• Can be powered via 3V3 (3.3V) or Vin (5V).
• Format MicroSD card to FAT32 (32KB clusters).
• Direct register CMSIS drivers for maximum speed.
